method.scope: Exact original BTCUSDT perpetual, chart/backtest dates interpreted as UTC, and archived published numeric parameters. Both start flat with 10,000 USDT benchmark equity because the archive omits starting capital. Inputs set leverage to the published 20x. Each source uses its original native Sleep/candle access and initial empty offline state. #4834 exercises the published single-symbol virtual mode. #4835 uses the source in which the live scanner call is already commented out.
method.market_data: Checksummed Binance USD-M historical trade and index candles and original eight-hour funding rates, with exact FMZ overlap after excluding one known partial terminal request row. FMZ uses a native 1h synthetic base tick model built from observed OHLC. All observed synthetic Last values remain inside the matching exchange candle. Native chart prior candles are checked separately. Broker output does not provide an historical maker queue or true fill guarantees.
method.execution: Full-quantity native simulated broker orders. All marketable orders cross exactly one native 0.1 USDT tick relative to reference Last, with contemporaneous 0.04% taker fee. #4834 resting sell exits first cross the simulated bid after placement, with native validation of full size and 0.02% maker fee. Canceled limits remain zero-filled. The broker applies its native BTC market precision of 0.001 quantity and 0.1 price tick to the archived order requests.
method.settlement: Each closed cycle is assigned independent cash changes at adjacent source-observed flat states. Observed native funding is isolated from gross realized fill P&L and both sides’ fees and independently tested against historical position size, signed rate schedules and contemporaneous contract and index price envelopes. Terminal unrealized values, open fees and open funding remain separate from closed results. No forced terminal exit.
method.drawdown: Gross, after-fee and net workbook columns are realized from complete cycles. The marked drawdown separately uses all source-observed changing account equity values and terminal equity. Open inventory materially changes the apparent profitability of #4835.

reproduction: Stage the pinned FMZ strategy ZIP and reuse the shared R29 Binance market binding helpers. Run the worker twice in the network-denied FMZ AppContainer. Pass both equal receipts and staged input to this Decimal verifier.
